name: lighting
description: Drive your real browser and any Windows app from Codex with compact text snapshots instead of screenshots.

interface.shortDescription: Your real browser and Windows apps, as a few lines of text
interface.longDescription: The lighting command drives your open Brave, Chrome or Edge through a small extension and any Windows app through UI Automation and OCR. Every action answers in one short line, snapshots list only what you can see.
defaultPrompt: Use Lighting to open example.com and tell me what is on the page.
